subject: ProcureOne onboarding: privacy pack, SOC 2 link, and PO routing
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@procureone.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@procureone.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier pack and privacy docs for Redwood onboarding

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the warm welcome. Attached are the supplier form and our current privacy/security pack you asked for: the signed supplier form, our corporate DPA (finalized 2025-12-01), the latest SOC 2 report for Q3 2025, and a current subprocessor list.

Quick notes:
- DPA: we use the standard ProcureOne DPA (attached) — happy to countersign if your legal team needs edits, but this is the executed copy we use for most customers.
- SOC 2: the SOC report is an abridged copy (no raw logs); full auditor contact is included in the cover letter.
- Subprocessors: we include AWS, FastCaches Inc., MetricsCo — see CSV.

Can you confirm the next steps for PO routing and whether Finance needs paper PO or an emailed invoice + vendor portal registration? Also: does Redwood need a DocuSign packet for the DPA or will a signed PDF suffice?

Attaching: ProcureOne_Supplier_Form.pdf, ProcureOne_DPA_2025-12-01.pdf, SOC2-Report-ProcureOne-Q3-2025.pdf, subprocessors_list_2025.csv

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Head of Vendor Operations
ProcureOne
anna.kim@procureone.com
+1 415-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@procureone.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier pack and privacy docs for Redwood onboarding

Hi Anna —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few items from our side so we can finish set-up: 

1) Legal review (DPA): I’ve looped in Laura (legal) to confirm whether we need redlines or can accept the provided executed copy. If Laura requests redlines, we’ll route a DocuSign packet.

2) Finance/PO: Rishi in Finance is CC’d — Rishi, what’s the preferred path for ProcureOne? Our usual flow is: vendor form + W-9 (US) -> system vendor creation -> PO issuance (we can issue standard terms PO referencing the DPA). If Procurement requires a signed DPA before vendor creation, let us know.

3) Subprocessors & SOC2: Laura, is the SOC 2 PDF and CSV sufficient as evidence? If you need the auditor contact or the full attestation letter, Anna indicated that can be provided.

Anna — could you also share: preferred remit-to for invoices, and whether you require a vendor portal invite to submit invoices (link or contact)?

Next step: once legal confirms DPA acceptance and Finance confirms PO path, I’ll open a vendor record and route the PO.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 917-555-0137

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, Anna Kim <anna.kim@procureone.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier pack and privacy docs for Redwood onboarding

Ben / Anna —

Thanks for sharing. Quick legal read below: 

- DPA: The provided DPA looks standard and acceptable for Redwood’s hosted inference product, except we need to confirm data residency and subprocessors clause alignment with our policy. I’ve flagged two small items for clarity: (a) incident notification timeline (request 48 hrs) and (b) auditor access scope. Can Anna confirm those points? If ProcureOne is amenable, we can proceed without counter-redlining; otherwise, send the DocuSign draft and I’ll propose targeted edits.

- SOC 2: The PDF looks fine for initial acceptance. Please forward the auditor contact (name + email) if possible — our compliance team sometimes requests direct confirmation.

- Subprocessors: Please provide a brief summary of any subprocessor that has access to customer-uploaded data (if any). The CSV is helpful but we need a short line item for each with the processing purpose.

I’ll hold approval pending those clarifications.

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: ProcureOne Finance <finance@procureone.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Anna Kim <anna.kim@procureone.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood PO & remit details

Hi Rishi —

Following up per Ben’s thread: we can accept standard PO issuance. Our preferred remit-to for Redwood to send POs is: accounts.payable@procureone.com (ACH details available on vendor portal). We also support emailed invoices to invoices@procureone.com if you prefer not to use the portal.

A few administrative items:
- Please confirm if Redwood requires ProcureOne to be set up in Coupa or if POs will be created and emailed.
- DocuSign preference: ProcureOne can sign the DPA in DocuSign; if Redwood needs a countersigned packet, please share the DocuSign link and we’ll complete.

Attached: ProcureOne_PO_instructions.txt (contains remit and ACH placeholder)

Thanks,
ProcureOne Finance Team
